background_story: In the whimsical land of Flibberdejibbet, Shmoopie was a lovable but hapless creature known for his tendency to clobber anything in his path. With a clumsy swipe of his oversized ears or a misdirected swing of his long, curly tail, Shmoopie would inadvertently knock over trees, smash through gardens, and even dent the occasional castle wall. Despite his best intentions, chaos seemed to follow him everywhere. One day, while trying to help with the annual Harvest Festival preparations, Shmoopie's clobbering antics accidentally created a massive, messy masterpiece that became the talk of the town. The Flibberdejibbetians, instead of scolding him, celebrated Shmoopie's unique talent and declared him the official 'Clobberer-in-Residence' – a title he wore with pride, if a bit sheepishly.
